takeaway: Guillain-Barré syndrome is a neuromuscular disease: hypoventilation raises PaCO2 and lowers pH, giving respiratory acidosis.

lines.text: Which arterial blood gas result does Guillain-Barré syndrome give?
lines.say: Which arterial blood gas result does Ghee-yan Barray syndrome give?

lines.text: It is a neuromuscular disease, so the patient cannot ventilate adequately.
Hypoventilation raises carbon dioxide in the blood.
Acute respiratory acidosis occurs with an abrupt failure of ventilation.
A raised PaCO2 decreases the bicarbonate to PaCO2 ratio, and the pH falls.
lines.say: A raised P A C O two decreases the bicarbonate to P A C O two ratio, and the P H falls.

lines.text: Other neuromuscular causes include myasthenia gravis and muscular dystrophy.
